title: Editor: debugger crash on `texture_get_data_async` callback
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: Godot v4.5.dev (64b09905c)

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (64b09905c) - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (nvidia; 570.133.07) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) Vulkan `1.4.303`, kernel `6.8.0-60-generic`

### Issue description

I am using `texture_get_data_async` from #100110, which works great, but putting a breakpoint in the callback results in a crash.

### Steps to reproduce

```python3
extends Node3D

var timer = Timer.new()

func _texture_data_callback(array):
	var break_me = 1
	print("this never prints")

func _ready():
	timer.wait_time = 2.0
	timer.one_shot = true
	timer.autostart = true
	timer.timeout.connect(_on_timer_timeout)
	add_child(timer)

func _on_timer_timeout():
	var rid = get_tree().get_root().get_viewport().get_texture().get_rid()
	var rd_rid = RenderingServer.texture_get_rd_texture(rid)
	var rd := RenderingServer.get_rendering_device()
	rd.texture_get_data_async(rd_rid, 0, _texture_data_callback)
```
